programs.rightsClaimSummary: Agios SEC 10-Q represents full ownership of PYRUKYND and AQVESME but details NewBridge GCC and Avanzanite EEA/Switzerland/UK regional commercialization rights. Statements are from issuer; independent licensing-contract adjudication and remaining territorial/indication scope are not established.

sourceDocuments.assertion: Agios June 2026 Form 10-Q states it has full ownership rights to the branded mitapivat products PYRUKYND and AQVESME and discloses July 2024 GCC commercialization grant to NewBridge and June 2025 EEA/Switzerland/UK commercialization grant to Avanzanite; current contracts and territorial exclusivity not independently adjudicated. States May 2026 SCD sNDA FDA accepted priority review with issuer-reported November 1, 2026 PDUFA and separate REIGNITE confirmatory Phase 3.

Agios press release says FDA accepted mitapivat supplemental NDA for sickle cell disease with Priority Review, PDUFA goal Nov 1 2026, under accelerated approval pathway; not an independent FDA primary letter or approval outcome.
Agios announces initial submission of mitapivat sickle-cell sNDA with confirmatory study plan under accelerated-approval pathway; not a decision.
Agios separates existing approved adult PK deficiency and thalassemia programs from sickle cell disease application (RISE UP, issuer-reported Nov 1 2026) and ongoing pediatric PK deficiency studies.
